market.question: Will IBM (IBM) beat quarterly earnings?

en.title: IBM Earnings Beat Odds Collapse
en.summary: The probability of IBM beating quarterly earnings plummeted to 4% after the company issued a preliminary warning that its Q2 earnings fell short of Wall Street's expectations. This direct corporate announcement triggered a massive sell-off in IBM shares.
drivers: IBM issues preliminary Q2 earnings warning
Company states Q2 results fell short of expectations
IBM shares drop 17-25% post-warning
en.why_matters: This event highlights the immediate and severe market reaction to corporate earnings warnings, impacting investor confidence and stock valuation. It sets a negative tone for IBM's near-term performance and potentially for the broader tech sector.
en.bull_case: Final results could be less negative than warned, slightly raising the slim chance of a technical beat against original consensus.
en.bear_case: IBM's explicit warning of falling short of expectations makes a beat virtually impossible, suggesting 4% is still too high.

zh.title: IBM盈利超预期概率暴跌
zh.summary: 在IBM发布第二季度盈利预警，称其业绩未达华尔街预期后，该公司盈利超预期的概率暴跌至4%。这一直接的公司声明引发了IBM股票的大规模抛售。
drivers: IBM发布第二季度盈利预警
公司称Q2业绩未达预期
预警后IBM股价下跌17-25%
zh.why_matters: 此次事件凸显了市场对企业盈利预警的即时和剧烈反应，影响投资者信心和股票估值。它为IBM的近期表现乃至更广泛的科技行业定下了负面基调。
zh.bull_case: 最终结果可能好于预警，略微提高技术性超预期机会。
zh.bear_case: IBM明确预警业绩不及预期，超越概率极低，4%仍显过高。
